notes.compatPort: some China-reachable TCP relays (e.g. hole-punching panels) pin their local target to one fixed port. nginx listens on compatPort too and forwards it to whichever slot is live, so a flip never breaks that entry.
notes.assets: public/assets and public/fonts are third-party game material and are NOT part of this package. Fetch them per server with the upstream tooling (npm run assets / tools/fetch-assets.mjs). Nothing here uploads them anywhere.
notes.secrets: no credential belongs in this file. If your launcher needs env vars (a shared server token, a tunnel token), read them from a file that stays out of git.
